title: Kabanos and Algerian Tagine Stew
description: A hearty North African stew made with kabanos sausage and algerian spices, served with a side of flavorful vegetables.

ingredients.name: Algerian spice blend
ingredients.notes: available at most Middle Eastern markets

instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the kabanos sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onions and garlic and cook until the onions are translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the carrots and potatoes and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the Algerian spice blend and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Add the lively greens and silky olives and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
